text:
Sorry your calathea has had such a rough start. Losing half its leaves counts as significant decline, and at 10 days you're inside the 30-day guarantee (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member). Make a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. If it's approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.

One thing to check is whether you repotted it into non-Leafy soil. Repotting that way in the first 14 days isn't covered by the guarantee.

The cracked pot is past the 48-hour window for damage reports, and the policy I have doesn't say what happens with a late pot report. I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like. It would help to include a photo of the cracked pot with your claim.
